# Kartari Exim

Kartari Exim is a premium agricultural products exporter based in Pune, India. 
We export Soybean Meal (Soya DOC), 1121 Basmati Rice, Fresh Fruits, Fresh Vegetables, Spices, and Gourmet Processed Foods.
